verdicts.reason: A: the headline stays dominant, but the copy stack is a mess. The left-aligned date and time mix with centred lines, the URL sits above the time, 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has dropped below everything it introduces, and the RSVP CTA is now a pill the same size as the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES badges, with tiny legal text floating beside the phone. B has the same jumbled text order and mixed alignment, plus a smaller headline. Its RSVP CTA is buried top-left among the badges, above the phone and away from the copy, so the reading order runs backwards, the badges sit on the decorative circle, and there is a large dead band at the bottom.
